$comment: Declared versions of this distribution that are NOT published FROM THIS
REPOSITORY, each with the reason it is acceptable. A declared version
nobody can install is detected here rather than discovered by a consumer's
State is computed from THIS repository's git tags. a1 and a2 were published
from dotmac_starter_mt and their tags stay there permanently — git
filter-repo rewrote every commit, so a tag recreated here would point at a
different tree and make one published version name two of them. Recording
those inherited coordinates is a separate, later step; this ledger answers
only 'may this repository declare that version unpublished'.

0.1.0a3.reason: First release from this repository. The package source changed after a2 was published (the eager-database-runtime boundary fix), so declaring a2 would make one version name two different contents. a3 is declared here and published by the release step; a2's artifact in the private index is untouched and remains the authoritative a2.
